description:
You are the Program Coordinator for the Midwest Digital Health Summit. Create a one-page 'Program at a Glance' schedule grid in Apache OpenOffice Writer using the data from /home/ga/Documents/schedule_data.json. 

Requirements:
1. Set the page orientation to LANDSCAPE.
2. Create a table with 4 columns: Time, Track A (Clinical), Track B (IT & Data), Track C (Policy).
3. The table must have a header row with these column titles.
4. Populate the table with the schedule items from the JSON file.
5. Formatting rule: Plenary sessions (Registration, Keynote, Lunch, Closing Panel) must span across the 3 track columns (merge cells so the text is centered across the tracks). Concurrent sessions should be placed in their respective columns.
6. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/Summit_Schedule_2025.odt.
